cases.statement: Three batch rows: an Italian hemizygous male proband with a full case report (32248794), and two citations of the female patient of Bottillo et al. 2016 (31464081 and 36876541 #4), which very likely describe one woman. 29463847 also cites the Bottillo heterozygous p.Phe151fs*32 case.

people.label: patient
people.key_phenotypes: severe biventricular hypertrophy (septum 30 mm) with atrial tachycardia and two episodes of ventricular fibrillation; mild intellectual disability; mild distal weakness; bilateral pes cavus; CK 562; autophagic vacuoles with sarcolemmal features

quotes.quote: Variant annotation results showed a hemizygous 1 bp deletion, c.453delT, in LAMP2 (NM_002294), which was confirmed by Sanger sequencing.
After 2 episodes of ventricular fibrillation within 2 years, genetic testing identified a novel LAMP2 pathogenic variant.
The echocardiogram confirmed the severe biventricular hypertrophy (LV septum thickness was 30 mm, PWT 23 mm and LVOT 30 mmHg), with mild LV outflow tract obstruction, previously documented.
These revealed mild intellectual disability, mild weakness of distal upper and lower limb muscles and bilateral pes cavus, with an elevated serum CK (562 UI/L).

The lysosomal vacuoles had the characteristics of autophagic vacuoles with unique sarcolemma features since the limiting membranes were positive for sarcolemma proteins such as dystrophin, sarcoglycans, dystroglycans, and caveolin.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Male proband: HCM with myopathy, intellectual disability and pes cavus, with muscle pathology the authors call concordant with Danon disease. An 11-gene HCM panel (sarcomere genes, PLN, LAMP2, GLA) found this as the reported variant; no other variant is reported.

quotes.quote: DNA isolated from peripheral blood leukocytes was screened for genes associated with HCM and related phenotypes using a sequencing panel (Custom Ion Panel, ThermoFisher-US) including 11 genes (MYBPC3, MYH7, TNNT2, TNNI3, TPM1, MYL2, MYL3, ACTC1, PLN, LAMP2, GLA), encoding for sarcomeric and non sarcomeric proteins.
Immunohistochemistry using anti-lysosome-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP2) antibodies revealed the absence of the protein in all fibers, concordant with a diagnosis of Danon disease.

segregation.statement: 32248794: the proband's older brother tested negative and is described as not at risk; the mother died at 24 of suspected postpartum DCM and was not tested (authors say she was probably a carrier). No family data for the Bottillo female in these texts.

quotes.quote: He then agreed to undergo targeted genetic testing for the disease causing variant. The result was negative, indicating that he is not at risk of developing manifestations of Danon disease.
His mother died of suspected postpartum DCM when she was 24 years old.
During counseling, it was explained that probably the mother was a carrier of the LAMP2 pathogenic variant, and that he had a 50% chance of having inherited it.

de_novo.statement: Parental testing is not reported for the male proband; the deceased mother was presumed to be a carrier but not tested. The father's status is not reported.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: One-base deletion predicted to cause a frameshift (p.(Phe151LeufsTer32)); 32248794 states the same protein change and a premature stop at codon 183.

quotes.quote: The variant (chrX:119582932_delT) causes a frameshift in exon 4, p.(F151Lfs*32) resulting in a putative premature stop codon at position 183 of the protein.

population_data_in_papers.statement: 32248794 states the variant is absent from gnomAD and other databases (variants with MAF above 1 x 10^-4 were filtered).

quotes.quote: To the best of our knowledge, it has not previously been reported in the literature, and it is absent in gnomAD and in other electronic databases, including ClinVar (ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar).
Then, we filtered out all the variants with an allelic frequency (MAF) of more than 1 × 10^− 4 in (gnomad.broadinstitute.org).

authors_classification.statement: 32248794 states an ACMG-based classification with two criteria, quoted here.

quotes.quote: In particular, the variant was classified as likely pathogenic based on the molecular defect (PVS1; frameshift with premature protein truncation) and on its allele frequency in the general population (PM2).

concerns: Same-person duplicate: DANON-ID0409 (31464081) and DANON-ID0468 (36876541 #4) both cite the single female of Bottillo et al. 2016 and are very likely one woman; the pipeline kept them apart.
Contradiction across papers: 32248794 (2020) says c.453delT had not been reported before, but 31464081, 36876541 and 29463847 cite Bottillo et al. 2016 for a female with c.453delT / p.Phe151fs*32.

Possible relationship to check: the 32248794 proband's untested mother died at 24 of suspected postpartum DCM, and the Bottillo female had HCM at 20 and a transplant at 23 (36876541). These texts cannot show whether they are related or the same woman; the panel may wish to check the Bottillo report (not in this batch).
32248794 gives a hg19-style coordinate (chrX:119582932_delT) and transcript NM_002294 without version.
The Bottillo female appears only in review tables and discussion sentences in this batch; her case report is not in this batch.
notes_for_panel: The male proband is fully described; the female is known only from citations. 30413001 also cites Bottillo et al. for mosaic LAMP2 staining in explanted heart muscle, without naming the variant.
